description: States (the world model, docs/world-model.md): one track per line, one thing in one aspect (location, possession, or a named condition), with the time windows the case's logic turns on. Each window is a slot st.<thing>.<at|held|condition>.<window>; null = left open by the story. Sparse: only what is declared here (or what the player opens) exists. Location values are a place set plus 'elsewhere' (a place's `within` folds it into the listed place containing it); possession values are people, animals and groups, the set's places (lying there) and 'elsewhere'. Every answer is given by a claim (its own line) or derived.

state_places.text: The places of Monday night on Dartmoor.
